purpose: control infrastructure verification, not task performance or B3
matched_start_required: all three boundary RNG stream states
neural state, queued events, selected weights and traces
allowed_start_differences: only the one declared control-policy field, wrong-note router label, or plasticity enabled flag for plasticity-off

expected_switch_behavior.baseline: source request, aligned artificial PAM delivery, actual PAM spikes and selected updates are distinct records
expected_switch_behavior.plasticity_off: actual PAM activity remains but selected weights do not change
expected_switch_behavior.wrong_note: aligned source pulse is held until the next actually observed different cue, then delivered
expected_switch_behavior.dan_disabled: source request remains; artificial current and PAM spikes are suppressed
expected_switch_behavior.eligibility_disabled: source request and PAM spikes remain; local traces and selected updates are blocked

do_not: interpret synthetic feedback as task outcome
